# Keystone Intelligence Group
> Irish AI consultancy building operational AI workflows for SMEs turning over €1M–€50M.

## About
Keystone Intelligence Group is an Irish AI consultancy that builds and deploys operational 
AI workflows for small and medium businesses. Fixed-price engagements. No retainers.

Founded by Jamie Walsh, CPA, former CFO of Kollect on Demand (Nasdaq Stockholm IPO, 
subsequently acquired by Irish private equity). Operational AI was built inside the 
partners' own businesses first — across waste management, financial services, construction 
and legal services — before being offered to clients.

## What We Do
- AI workflow design and implementation for Irish SMEs
- Fixed-price builds from €8,000
- Discovery Report (€999, credited against build if you proceed)
- Free 20-minute Discovery Call
- Ongoing agent development from €1,000 per workflow

## Proven Builds (Internal)
- Nine-agent operations hub running a 30-vehicle waste management business
- Invoice reconciliation across Salesforce and Xero (AR Guardian)
- WIP-to-invoice automation
- Email triage agent (Emily) — five-tier classification with feedback loop
- Month-end balance sheet reconciliation agent

## Client Builds
- AI operations hub for an Irish construction company (five workflows)
- Client call transcription and action item extraction for an Irish solicitor practice

## Target Market
Irish businesses turning over €1M–€50M across any sector. The Keystone proposition 
is operational pattern recognition across sectors — not sector specialisation.
